summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience building computer vision and generative AI systems in PyTorch. Built a GPT-2 style Transformer and fine-tuned DONUT (Vision Transformer) for multimodal document understanding; trained CNN pipelines with YOLOv8, U-Net, and ResNet across detection, segmentation, and high-resolution image reconstruction tasks.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.
Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset for text extraction.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank for noise suppression combined with optimized stitching and concurrency, achieving PSNR of 86.
Built a custom image-stitching pipeline using bit manipulation and averaging; achieved PSNR 65 vs. homography-based stitching baseline.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±18% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net with VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50 backbones; benchmarked Dice Score, IoU, and accuracy-latency trade-offs.
Built a custom data pipeline for BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI with medical imaging augmentation and memory-efficient 3D batch loading.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 models, improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed in a consumer mobile app.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch with multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Achieved 15% WER on Hindi-English dataset while reducing preprocessing latency via optimized tokenization.
Built end-to-end ASR with mel spectrogram encoder and causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention; loss ~0.51 on 1,000 NPTEL samples.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced model memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; observed ~7% accuracy drop and +6.3 perplexity increase.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
